authorization: User requested a common justified temporal calendar, embargo, HPO budget, metrics, selection criteria and separation of known data from final test; explicitly rejected assuming eleven full searches.
registration_scope: Prospective amendment for affected future work, with previously observed data and prior fits explicitly disclosed; not retroactive original preregistration.

locators: F2a p30: common rolling-origin evaluation and embargo, without a literal eleven-search count
Section11 p46: fair HPO opportunities or budget
Section14.5 p56: full search in every outer fold when cost permits
Section9 p43: pilot-based power, delta, multiplicity and honest resource limitations

contract.primary_metric: mean of per-seed RMSE in original units
contract.cv_origins: Ten monthly refits January-October 2024; only three HPO updates
contract.final_origin: 2025-01-01 historical exploratory refit; independent future origin bound only after global freeze
contract.final_test_role: Known 608+60 dates remain exploratory; future independent test is a separately bound prospective cohort

calendar_justification.anchors: Initial deployment, midyear update and pre-power-pilot update. Disjoint 83-day local validation windows and identical update schedule for all systems; this is a fixed coverage/cost decision, not proof that three anchors suffice.
calendar_justification.outer_refits: Retain ten disjoint monthly evaluations and fresh expanding-history fits; carry only the most recently available recipe forward.
calendar_justification.no_retrospective_future_recipe: A July/October recipe may never be used for an earlier outer forecast.
calendar_justification.stability_report: Report errors, winner/configuration changes and uncertainty by origin; no post-test anchor additions without a new amendment.
calendar_justification.interpretation: Causal staged-update rolling-origin procedure; not full nested HPO/NAS repeated in every fold.

hpo.method: seeded stratified random; frozen candidate list before fits
hpo.weight_decay_scope: weight matrices only; biases and normalization parameters exempt
hpo.loss: MSE of sigma7 divided by positive training mean
hpo.supervised_selection: lowest original-unit validation RMSE; strict improvement; earliest epoch on equal score
hpo.scheduler: cosine decay after warmup; minLR0; default warmup0; epoch caps50/200 respected
hpo.batch_singleton_rule: if remainder1 split preceding full batch into batch_size-1 and2; keep all rows; require at least2 train examples
hpo.failure_policy: NaN/inf/divergence/timeout/OOM consume configuration and stage allocation; preserve run records, no replacement seed/trial. Systematic implementation error blocks campaign, requires correction and affected reruns under amendment.
hpo.refit: Fresh model, optimizers and train-only scalers. For each origin/recipe use ceil(median(best epochs)) of selected HPO configuration's two seeds (nonNAS) or winning NAS finalist's five phase2 seeds, per phase separately. Freeze those counts for every new refit seed; no outer-label early stopping. Count AE1/AE2/supervised separately.
hpo.auxiliary_objective: MSE reconstructing X/s; fresh optimizer each AE stage; select on inner-validation reconstruction loss with same patience; full200/short50 epoch caps per stage
hpo.configuration_selection: Smallest mean original-unit validation RMSE across the two HPO seeds; exact-score tie resolved by stable trial ID. NAS uses its distinct five-seed architecture selection rule.
hpo.selection_scope: LOCAL at each registered anchor, never pooled over later anchors
hpo.opportunity_rule: 18 fixed candidate points per neural model per anchor, two fixed paired seeds
hpo.restored_structural_axes: Fixed under the published architecture policy; no old NAS recipe aliases
hpo.epochs_to_refit: ceil(median(best epochs)) separately by optimization phase; two HPO seeds, or five initial TiDE NAS2 seeds

ARIMA.selection: lowest common validation RMSE; stable order-grid ID on exact tie

SeasonalNaive.selection: lowest common validation RMSE; stable shorter-period order on exact tie

nas.patterns: all eight bit triplets; no pruning
nas.k_rule: TiDE only: k40 if the median pairwise Spearman rank correlation over 12 designs and five full-budget pilot seeds is below0.5 or not estimable; otherwise k20. Freeze before NAS1.
nas.reference_addition: If reference already among k distinct finalists do not repeat it; budget conservatively reserves k+1
nas.hpo_order: First tune nonarchitecture HPO on reference; then freeze winning nonarchitecture values before1000 NAS designs.
nas.remaining_dropout: all newly searched block positions controlled solely by bit pattern at p0.2; other dropout0
nas.selection: minimize mean validation RMSE; within delta of lowest mean or overlapping nominal95% mean-score t intervals, select fewest total predictor params, then lowest mean RMSE, then stable architecture id; overlap is tie rule, not equivalence proof
order: freeze initial architecture before first outer forecast
nas.later_anchors: HPO on the SAME initial NAS winner, never return to reference and never rerun full NAS

epoch_rule.2024-01-01: phasewise ceil median of the five winning NAS2 best epochs
epoch_rule.2024-07-01: phasewise ceil median of the two local HPO best epochs on frozen initial architecture
epoch_rule.2024-10-01: phasewise ceil median of the two local HPO best epochs on frozen initial architecture

nas.indistinguishable_set: TOST/ROPE/MCS with applicable assumptions and recorded uncertainty remains a separate required analysis; nominal CI overlap alone is not equivalence
nas.full_outer_fold_NAS_omission_basis: Guide section14.5 p56 makes repeating full NAS per outer fold conditional on cost; report initial-regime architecture and temporal stability limitations

noise_pilot.architecture_selection: reference plus smallest000 and largest111, plus9 stratified seeded unique candidates fixed before timing; one retained TiDE family
noise_pilot.purpose: Only resource/rank-noise estimates and k, never candidate/model selection; no HPO winner from later data is used.

metrics.primary: mean of individual-seed RMSE in original unannualized sigma7 units on the same frozen eligible dates
metrics.development_aggregation: For each paired seed concatenate eligible January-October outer dates, compute its RMSE, then average seeds. Also report each origin separately.
metrics.MAPE: Only y>0, disclose eligible coverage; retain zero labels for primary RMSE.
metrics.scales: MASE and RMSSE denominators use only consecutive daily pairs of finite admissible training targets, never jump gaps or use evaluation labels.
metrics.invalid_denominators: Return unavailable with reason and coverage, never substitute zero/epsilon silently.
metrics.deterministic_baselines: One deterministic trajectory per cohort; no fabricated independent seed replications.
metrics.common_support: Same predeclared quality/calendar mask across all systems; no date deletion because a model failed.

selection.hpo: Minimize mean validation RMSE over exactly the two paired seeds at that anchor; exact tie by stable trial ID.
selection.epochs: Strict improvement/earliest checkpoint; refit per-phase ceil median of best epochs from relevant HPO or initial NAS2 seeds.
selection.nas: Retain registered parsimony tie rule and separate formal indistinguishability analysis; reference exactly once.
selection.outer_labels: Never select hyperparameters, architecture or early stopping from an outer/final label.
selection.development_top3: Choose analysis targets from development-only results, before prospective final labels; final-test-driven follow-ups remain explicitly exploratory.

inference.multiplicity: Holm across all twenty primary contrasts
inference.planning_effect_explanation: The primary null already includes delta; simulate true gain2delta, giving a delta-sized separation from the null boundary. Power0.80 is not claimed at true gain=delta.
inference.other_pairwise_comparisons: Exploratory, explicitly labelled, with effects/CI and a separate complete Holm family if tested; never substitute their p-values for primary tests.
inference.resampling: Paired seed and temporal-block resampling on common dates; deterministic baseline resampled over time only.
inference.three_admissible_tests_status: pending implementation and assumption checks before independent-final access; temporal block bootstrap and suitable forecast-loss tests are not assumed valid merely by being named.
inference.finalist_equivalence_status: TOST/ROPE/MCS applicability and reporting pending; overlapping nominal intervals are not proof.
inference.nas_family_control: The NAS finalist family is separate and labelled; no claim of one globalFWER across every secondary/NAS contrast.

power.recipe_basis: October2024 HPO; power-pilot labels may determine R/dependence/MDE but cannot retune recipes.
power.acceptance: Choose smallest common R6..30 whose predeclared multiplicity-aware paired temporal simulation has Wilson95% lower power bound at least0.80 under true gain2delta; hold bias/dependence assumptions fixed before final access.
power.if_no_R_meets_target: Report achieved power/MDE and resource limitation. Do not assert power0.80 or silently add seeds; any increase beyond pool/cap needs an explicit amendment.
power.temporal_transport_limit: Pilot2024 does not by itself establish power in a future2026/2027 regime; one hundred calendar dates do not guarantee temporal power.
power.power_definition: Minimum marginal power over the prespecified representative contrasts/scenarios, never probability of rejecting at least one null. Use Bonferroni0.05/20 for conservative planning; Holm remains the final twenty-test procedure.
power.unpiloted_contrasts: Use a declared conservative pilot variance/dependence envelope as a planning proxy; disclose that only representative models were piloted. Do not claim measured power for all unobserved models or a future regime.
power.monte_carlo_interval: One-sided95% Wilson lower bound (z1.6448536269514722) describes Monte Carlo error only, not uncertainty in pilot variance estimates or transport to future data.
power.MDE_units: Raw minimum detectable gain equals margin delta plus the detectable separation from the margin null.
power.short_pilot_limit: The53-day pilot contains few independent14-day blocks; report sensitivity and uncertainty rather than treating Monte Carlo draws as additional data.

historical_608.interpretation: exploratory historical E2 replay, not independent confirmatory test

historical_60.interpretation: known reserve; may support declared future calibration, never relabel as virgin test

independent_final.start_rule: EXACTLY the UTC day after global freeze; register the binding BEFORE that day starts. A late binding is rejected, not silently shifted.
independent_final.coverage_limit: If any exclusions leave fewer than100 eligible cases, report the shortfall and leave that error-analysis criterion open; never extend based on performance.
independent_final.bridge_policy: New bridge data have not been acquired by this amendment; admit only causally observed OHLCV/ARIMA state, never weights, scalers, calibration or HPO updates.
independent_final.lineage: New future-fit weights trained on known labels throughAug24 2026 are distinct from historical Jan2025 weights. They must not re-score608known dates as out-of-sample.
freeze_requirements: common R and seed list with power receipt
calibrators fitted only on the known calibration block
hash and physical artifact verification on the executing worker
cohort binding before its first target date

budget.accounting: Preserve all consumed/reserved/unknown-attempt charges from both prior ledgers and any open session; a new plan/version does not reset time.
budget.admission: No new market job until a migration receipt reconciles current heads, consumed and reserved seconds. Admit only if the whole registered reservation fits the shared remaining allowance.
budget.insufficient_budget: Record incomplete work/limitation; no automatic extension, seed replacement, retry, ledger deletion or false completion.
budget.scope: All amended continuation training work charges the same remaining authorized campaign allowance; the inventory below is not a promise that it fits.

compatibility: Reuse only exact recipe, architecture, optimizer point, data/prepared tensors, origin, seed, stage and execution-policy identities; four restored bodies cannot reuse old NAS outcomes under new IDs. Later TiDE HPO must match the frozen initial winning architecture, not merely its model name.

execution_gates.closure: Git commit binds protocol, source hashes and registration receipt before affected new fits.
Both prior ledgers and active/unknown reservations reconciled without resetting the64h total.
Twelve TiDE designs, five pilot seeds, rank-noise rule and frozen k receipt before NAS1.
Three-model paired pilot, explicit twenty-contrast family, temporal simulation, common R and achieved power/MDE receipt.
Versioned CUDA fit/inference controller consumes the new schedule/recipe lineage and passes real-GPU preflight.
Known data roles and new causal bridge source manifests, derivative hashes and common supports audited on the worker.
Admissible contrast battery, assumptions, equivalence/MCS procedure and analysis code fixed before independent-final data.
Actual material checkpoint/calibrator verification plus all-system global-freeze receipt and cohort binding beforeT.
One hundred fixed calendar target days have closed; common support and first-access chronology verified.

registration_time_source: git_registration.json committed_at_utc is the actual immutable registration time; prepared_at_utc only dates document preparation. A future worker must bind the freeze to the actual Git registration timestamp.
